otrf-empire-launcher-vbs.description: Empire VBS launcher: wscript.exe starts an encoded PowerShell stager.

otrf-empire-runkey-standard-user.description: Empire agent as a standard user writes an HKCU Run key that relaunches an encoded stager; about 40k events of host background.

otrf-empire-runkey-elevated-user.description: Empire agent as an elevated user writes an HKLM Run key.

otrf-empire-reg-dump-sam.description: Empire agent shell runs reg.exe save HKLM\sam.

otrf-bitsadmin-download.description: cmd.exe runs bitsadmin.exe /transfer to download a file from GitHub.

otrf-sam-copy-esentutl.description: esentutl.exe copies the SAM hive through a volume shadow copy (/y /vss).
